source: SEC Form N-PORT, full fund universe; the mark is the median of fund-reported prices across the funds holding the bond, computed by Kilambi Research from the SEC bulk data
method: Quarterly fund marks, one per N-PORT archive quarter, each dated at the modal report-ending period among the bond's reporting funds. Funds file about 60 days after period end, so the newest mark lags the market. Not live trade prices.
ytm_method: Yield: semiannual compounding, 30/360, settlement at period end for marks and at the trade date for prints. Yield to worst where a call schedule is on record; conditional convertible redemption is not treated as a call. Shown only where coupon and maturity are on record.
